policies.title: Return & Refund Policy
policies.body:
Local items: returns are accepted within 3 days of delivery if the product is damaged, wrong, or defective. Contact us on WhatsApp with your order details and a photo.

Items shipped from China are not returnable once delivered.

Any item that is broken, damaged, burnt, or misused by the customer after delivery is not eligible for return.

Once a return is received and approved, the refund is processed and may take up to 1 week to reach you.

policies.title: Shipping & Delivery
policies.body:
Local orders: usually delivered within 3-5 working days across Pakistan. Cash on Delivery is available, and you will get a call or WhatsApp message before delivery.

Items shipped directly from China: delivery normally takes 10-15 days.

policies.title: Privacy Policy
policies.body:
We only collect the details needed to process your order: your name, phone number, and delivery address.

This information is used only to deliver your order and contact you about it. It is never sold and is not shared with anyone outside what is needed to fulfil your order.
